name: F.P. Journe Tourbillon Souverain à Remontoire d'Égalité
description: The F.P. Journe Tourbillon Souverain à Remontoire d’Egalité is known for its pioneering mechanical innovations, including a constant force device (remontoir d’égalité) designed for enhanced timekeeping accuracy. This mechanism ensures that energy from the mainspring is consistently delivered to the escapement, reducing variations in timekeeping as the watch unwinds. Additionally, the watch features a "dead seconds" complication (seconde morte), where the seconds hand remains stationary until each second has passed, an uncommon feature that provides precise time indication and highlights F.P. Journe's commitment to horological precision.
